plugins.name: economico
plugins.description: Discover the business behind your product. Your agent reads your code, Stripe and email, then keeps real double-entry books in Economico: customers and contracts, invoices and payments, vendor bills and receipts, investor updates. Ask your burn, runway or revenue and see the entries behind every number. Free forever for a single founder under $10k a month in recognized revenue.
